research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: spotLESS Materials is researching formulations and processes to generate repellent surfaces on medical devices and other substrates. Titles such as formulations and processes to generate repellent surfaces on medical devices, repellent coating formulation with low volatile organic compounds, and repellent coatings for high temperature surfaces describe bonded silane or siloxane layers combined with lubricants to yield low VOC, thermally stable, liquid repellent coatings. Their work spans medical, general, and high temperature repellent surfaces.

overview_description.description: spotLESS Materials engineers nature-inspired, ultra-repellent coatings that prevent fouling from liquids, sludge, bacteria, and mineral deposits. Their flagship technology, LESS (Liquid-Entrenched Smooth Surface), was originally developed to address sanitation challenges in low-water toilets. Inspired by the slippery surfaces of pitcher plants, LESS forms a molecularly smooth, liquid-infused barrier that significantly reduces the need for water, chemicals, and manual cleaning.

product.name: spotLESS Toilet Coating
product.description: A surface coating applied inside and outside toilet bowls to create an ultra-smooth barrier that prevents buildup and reduces cleaning effort.

product.name: spotLESS Glass & Mirror Coating
product.description: A coating for glass and mirror surfaces that creates a water-repellent, anti-scaling barrier to reduce soap scum and hard water buildup.

product.name: spotLESS Sink & Fixture Coating
product.description: A surface coating for sinks and fixtures that prevents buildup of toothpaste, soap scum, and grime, easing cleaning tasks.

product.name: spotLESS Windshield Treatment Kit
product.description: A hydrophobic coating for vehicle windshields that repels water, ice, and environmental contaminants to improve visibility and ease cleaning.
